from pathlib import Path
programs=Path('/home/ubuntu/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/runs/adhoc-primeagentlearner-1792545741/attempts/24c6b32aa5ef47bea0ad877ddcf721da/system/state/workspace/programs')
programs.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
code='''def transform(grid):
    g=[row[:] for row in grid]
    h,w=len(g),len(g[0])
    # Extend each diagonal run of at least two matching non-background cells.
    for dr,dc in ((1,1),(1,-1)):
        for r in range(h):
            for c in range(w):
                color=g[r][c]
                if color==1:
                    continue
                # Only start at the first cell of a same-color run.
                pr,pc=r-dr,c-dc
                if 0<=pr<h and 0<=pc<w and g[pr][pc]==color:
                    continue
                run=[]; rr,cc=r,c
                while 0<=rr<h and 0<=cc<w and g[rr][cc]==color:
                    run.append((rr,cc)); rr+=dr; cc+=dc
                if len(run)<2:
                    continue
                # Continue both ends along the same diagonal, stopping at any object.
                for sr,sc in ((-dr,-dc),(dr,dc)):
                    rr,cc=(run[0] if sr<0 or (sr==0 and sc<0) else run[-1])
                    # With diagonals, negative row direction denotes the first end.
                    if sr>0:
                        rr,cc=run[-1]
                    else:
                        rr,cc=run[0]
                    rr+=sr; cc+=sc
                    while 0<=rr<h and 0<=cc<w and g[rr][cc]==1:
                        g[rr][cc]=color
                        rr+=sr; cc+=sc
    return g
'''
p=programs/'task-2ad511f5.py'; p.write_text(code)
exec(compile(code,str(p),'exec'),globals())

out=transform(D)
